batch.title: Canonical events and ingestion
batch.goal: Make events_v2 canonical across provider ingestion, reconciliation, event lifecycle, provisioning, and publication.
exitCriteria: Legacy event writes are retired and ID reconciliation reports zero unexplained discrepancies.
Provider ingestion through Admin publication passes with retry, rollback, and audit evidence.

findings.title: Two disjoint event universes: legacy events (sync/claims/artist flows) vs canonical events_v2 (tours/calendar) with no bridge
findings.solution: Pick canonical table or build documented sync bridge
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Event publish/provision/tour-assignments endpoints have zero UI callers; status dropdown may shortcut readiness
findings.solution: Build UI wiring or remove endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Orphaned/dormant surfaces: events claims/duplicates/providers/sync unreachable + flag-gated global-admin trust model
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

specTasks.title: Canonical event/tour records
acceptanceCriteria: Authority of `tours`, `events_v2`, and normalized `tour_stops`; legacy adapter and retirement dates

specTasks.title: Converge event access and APIs
acceptanceCriteria: Builder, command center, advance, check-in, files, and live operations use the same org/event capability service and child-record checks.

specTasks.title: Normalize event setup fields
acceptanceCriteria: Venue relation, promoter/contact, local times, capacities, age/curfew, production windows, and ownership have typed destinations and validation.

specTasks.title: Replace best-effort seeds
acceptanceCriteria: Event creation returns explicit setup checklist for staffing, ticketing, advance, logistics, and finance; provisioning commands show exact changes/failures and never invent capacity/shift data.

specTasks.title: Add event version/conflict handling
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent changes and tour-plan changes surface version conflict or approved reconciliation; no silent overwrite.

specTasks.title: Unify readiness rules
acceptanceCriteria: Event readiness has stable rule IDs/severity/evidence/remediation and is used by builder, command center, and server publication.

specTasks.title: Add event setup completeness view
acceptanceCriteria: Each required domain shows not started/in progress/blocked/ready with owner and direct action; dependency failure is shown as unknown.

workflows.title: Provider Event Ingestion and Reconciliation

producer.outcome: Imports or reconciles provider event data.

recipients.outcome: Reviews conflicts, claims, and provider health before organization exposure.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Provider principals can write only through reviewed internal jobs; organization users receive only resolved events linked to their organization.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: A reviewed events_v2 record or an explicit unresolved/quarantined conflict is produced.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.title: Event Lifecycle, Provisioning, and Publication

producer.outcome: Creates, provisions, validates, and publishes an event.

recipients.outcome: Receives the published event and current itinerary.
Receives only the evaluated publication projection.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Only authorized organization actors may mutate or publish; recipient projections cannot expose Admin data.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Recipients see the exact published version and Admin sees delivery state.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: events_v2, canonical tour access, and persisted plan/publication services
invariants: Legacy event identifiers are exposed only through the governed migration mapping.

launchGates.title: Repository and staging migration parity
launchGates.acceptance: Named staging schema, policies, grants, buckets, functions, and migration versions match the immutable commit.

launchGates.title: Canonical event lifecycle passes
launchGates.acceptance: Provider ingestion, events_v2, tour assignment, publication, calendar, and Artist delivery reconcile with zero unexplained delta.
